article.title: Volusia DSA Confronts Florida’s “Beachside Bourgeois”
article.author: Democratic Left
article.content: The newly official east-central Florida DSA chapter wants to be a voice for "downwardly-mobile working people" in U.S. Rep. Randy Fine's backyard. The post Volusia DSA Confronts Florida’s “Beachside Bourgeois” appeared first on Democratic Left .
